```typescriptreact
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="ALL">TODOS</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <Select value={licenseTypeFilter} onValueChange={setLicenseTypeFilter}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-48">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Filtrar por Licensetype" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="ALL">TODOS</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="TYPE1">TIPO 1</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="TYPE2">TIPO 2</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Listado</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-8">Cargando...</div>
            ) : filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">No hay datos</div>
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-border/50">
                      <th className="text-left p-4">ID</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-4">Model Name</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-4">Model Id</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-4">Displayname</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-4">Description</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-4">Version</th>
                      <th className="text-center p-4">Acciones</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filteredItems.map((item) => (
                      <tr
                        key={item.id}
                        className="border-b border-border/30 hover:bg-background/50 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <td className="p-4">{item.id}</td>
                        <td className="p-4">{item.modelName}</td>
                        <td className="p-4">{item.modelId}</td>
                        <td className="p-4">{item.displayName}</td>
                        <td className="p-4">{item.description}</td>
                        <td className="p-4">{item.version}</td>
                        <td className="p-4">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                              <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </Button>
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300">
                              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardBody,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Activity,
  CheckCircle2,
  HeartPulse,
  RefreshCw,
  Rocket,
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  Settings,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
interface DashboardMetrics {
  totalAgents: number;
  activeAgents: number;
  deployedAgents: number;
  healthScore: number;
  avgPerformanceScore: number;
  offlineAgents: number;
  recentAgents: Array<{
    id: number;
    name: string;
    status: string;
    version: string;
  }>;
}
export default function AgentsDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<DashboardMetrics | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboardData();
  }, []);
  const loadDashboardData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/dashboard/metrics");
      const data = await response.json();
      setMetrics(data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading dashboard:", error);
      // Mock data para desarrollo
      setMetrics({
        totalAgents: 24,
        activeAgents: 18,
        deployedAgents: 15,
        healthScore: 87,
        avgPerformanceScore: 92,
        offlineAgents: 3,
        recentAgents: [
          { id: 1, name: "Agent Alpha", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v2.1.0" },
          { id: 2, name: "Agent Beta", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v1.9.5" },
          { id: 3, name: "Agent Gamma", status: "DEPLOYED", version: "v2.0.3" },
          { id: 4, name: "Agent Delta", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v1.8.2" },
        ],
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const kpiCards = metrics
    ? [
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.totalAgents", "Total Agentes"),
          value: metrics.totalAgents.toString(),
          icon: Users,
          color: "#3b82f6",
          gradient: "from-blue-500 to-blue-600",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.activeAgents", "Agentes Activos"),
          value: metrics.activeAgents.toString(),
          icon: CheckCircle2,
          color: "#10b981",
          gradient: "from-green-500 to-green-600",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.deployedAgents", "Agentes Desplegados"),
          value: metrics.deployedAgents.toString(),
          icon: Rocket,
          color: "#8b5cf6",
          gradient: "from-purple-500 to-purple-600",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.healthScore", "Health Score"),
          value: `${metrics.healthScore}%`,
          icon: HeartPulse,
          color: "#ef4444",
          gradient: "from-red-500 to-red-600",
        },
      ]
    : [];
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full bg-background">
      <div className="w-full px-6 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Bot className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {t("agents.dashboard.title", "Dashboard de Agentes")}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                {t("agents.dashboard.subtitle", "Métricas y estado general de agentes AI")}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button
            onClick={loadDashboardData}
            disabled={loading}
            variant="outline"
            className="gap-2"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            {t("common.refresh", "Refrescar")}
          </Button>
        </div>
        {/* KPI Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {kpiCards.map((kpi, index) => (
            <div
              key={index}
              className="group transition-all duration-700 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-2xl bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden relative hover:bg-card/90"
              style={{
                animationDelay: `${index * 150}ms`,
                animation: "fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out forwards",
              }}
            >
              <Card className="h-full">
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/20 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-700 transform -skew-x-12 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%]" />
                <div
                  className="absolute inset-0 rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500"
                  style={{
                    background: `linear-gradient(45deg, ${kpi.color}40, transparent, ${kpi.color}40)`,
                    backgroundSize: "200% 200%",
                    animation: "shimmer 2s ease-in-out infinite",
                  }}
                />
                <CardBody className="p-4 relative z-10">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium mb-1 text-muted-foreground transition-colors duration-300 group-hover:text-foreground">
                        {kpi.title}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground transition-all duration-300 group-hover:scale-110">
                        {kpi.value}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl ml-3 transition-all duration-500 group-hover:scale-110 group-hover:rotate-6 relative overflow-hidden`}
                      style={{
                        background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${kpi.color}20, ${kpi.color}10)`,
                        borderColor: kpi.color,
                        borderWidth: "2px",
                        boxShadow: `0 0 25px ${kpi.color}50, inset 0 0 20px ${kpi.color}10`,
                      }}
                    >
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/30 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500 transform translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%]" />
                      <kpi.icon
                        className="w-5 h-5 transition-all duration-500 group-hover:scale-110 relative z-10"
                        style={{ color: kpi.color }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardBody>
              </Card>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {/* Additional Metrics */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          {/* Recent Agents */}
          <Card className="bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Activity className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                {t("agents.dashboard.recentAgents", "Agentes Recientes")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              {loading ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}
                </div>
              ) : metrics?.recentAgents ? (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {metrics.recentAgents.map((agent, index) => (
                    <div
                      key={agent.id}
                      className="group/item p-3 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-card/50 hover:scale-[1.02] relative overflow-hidden"
                      style={{
                        animationDelay: `${index * 100}ms`,
                        animation: "fadeInLeft 0.6s ease-out forwards",
                      }}
                    >
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/5 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover/item:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 transform -skew-x-12 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover/item:translate-x-[100%]" />
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between relative z-10">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1">
                          <div
                            className="p-2 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 group-hover/item:scale-110 group-hover/item:rotate-3"
                            style={{
                              backgroundColor: "#3b82f620",
                              boxShadow: "0 0 15px #3b82f630",
                            }}
                          >
                            <Bot
                              className="w-4 h-4 transition-all duration-300"
                              style={{ color: "#3b82f6" }}
                            />
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex-1">
                            <p className="font-medium text-foreground text-sm">
                              {agent.name}
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              {t("agents.dashboard.version", "Versión")}: {agent.version}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium ${
                            agent.status === "ACTIVE"
                              ? "bg-green-500/20 text-green-500"
                              : agent.status === "DEPLOYED"
                              ? "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-500"
                              : "bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-500"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {agent.status}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          {/* Performance Metrics */}
          <Card className="bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                {t("agents.dashboard.performanceMetrics", "Métricas de Rendimiento")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              {loading ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}
                </div>
              ) : metrics ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-card/50 border border-border">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        {t("agents.dashboard.avgPerformanceScore", "Score Promedio")}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-primary">
                        {metrics.avgPerformanceScore}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          width: `${metrics.avgPerformanceScore}%`,
                          backgroundColor: "#3b82f6",
                          boxShadow: "0 0 10px #3b82f650",
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-card/50 border border-border">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        {t("agents.dashboard.offlineAgents", "Agentes Offline")}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-red-500">
                        {metrics.offlineAgents}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          width: `${(metrics.offlineAgents / metrics.totalAgents) * 100}%`,
                          backgroundColor: "#ef4444",
                          boxShadow: "0 0 10px #ef444450",
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
                        {metrics.avgPerformanceScore}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          width: `${metrics.avgPerformanceScore}%`,
                          backgroundColor: "#3b82f6",
                          boxShadow: "0 0 10px #3b82f650",
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-card/50 border border-border">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        {t("agents.dashboard.offlineAgents", "Agentes Offline")}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-red-500">
                        {metrics.offlineAgents}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          width: `${(metrics.offlineAgents / metrics.totalAgents) * 100}%`,
                          backgroundColor: "#ef4444",
                          boxShadow: "0 0 10px #ef444450",
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";

  ArrowLeft,

} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";

interface ProjectDetail {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  status: "active" | "completed" | "on-hold" | "cancelled";
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  budget: number;
  spent: number;
  teamSize: number;
  progress: number;
  domain?: string;
  owner?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

const mockProject: ProjectDetail = {
  id: 1,
  name: "Proyecto Alpha",
  description: "Sistema de gestión empresarial completo con módulos de contabilidad, recursos humanos y CRM.",
  status: "active",
  startDate: "2024-01-15",
  endDate: "2024-12-31",
  budget: 500000,
  spent: 325000,
  teamSize: 12,
  progress: 65,
  domain: "Gestión Empresarial",
  owner: "Juan Pérez",
  createdAt: "2024-01-10T00:00:00Z",
  updatedAt: "2024-11-15T10:30:00Z",
};

export default function ProjectDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const id = params?.id as string || "1";
  const project = mockProject;

  const budgetPercentage = (project.spent / project.budget) * 100;
  const daysRemaining = Math.ceil(
    (new Date(project.endDate).getTime() - new Date().getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
  );

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "active":
        return "default";
      case "completed":
        return "secondary";
      case "on-hold":
        return "outline";
      case "cancelled":
        return "destructive";
      default:
        return "outline";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">

                <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />

            <div>

                {project.name}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">{project.description}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Badge variant={getStatusColor(project.status) as any}>
              {t(`governance.projects.status.${project.status}`, project.status)}
            </Badge>
            <Button>
              <Edit className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              {t("common.edit", "Editar")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">

              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">

                  <div>
                    <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">

              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.projects.detail.completion", "Completado")}</span>
                    <span className="font-medium">{project.progress}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-3">
                    <div
                      className="bg-primary h-3 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                      style={{ width: `${project.progress}%` }}

                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  {daysRemaining > 0

            </Card>

          <div className="space-y-6">

              <CardHeader>

                  <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                  {t("governance.projects.detail.budget", "Presupuesto")}
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("governance.projects.detail.total", "Total")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-lg font-bold">${(project.budget / 1000).toLocaleString()}K</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("governance.projects.detail.spent", "Gastado")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-lg font-bold">${(project.spent / 1000).toLocaleString()}K</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("governance.projects.detail.remaining", "Restante")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-lg font-bold">
                    ${((project.budget - project.spent) / 1000).toLocaleString()}K
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2 mt-2">
                  <div
                    className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                    style={{ width: `${budgetPercentage}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                  {t("governance.projects.detail.team", "Equipo")}
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("governance.projects.detail.teamSize", "Tamaño del Equipo")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-lg font-bold">{project.teamSize} {t("governance.projects.detail.members", "miembros")}</p>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Settings className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />

              <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                <div>
```

Reemplazando el otro uso de Bot en el dashboard:


```typescriptreact
"use client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardBody,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Activity,
  CheckCircle2,
  HeartPulse,
  RefreshCw,
  Rocket,
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  Settings,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
interface DashboardMetrics {
  totalAgents: number;
  activeAgents: number;
  deployedAgents: number;
  healthScore: number;
  avgPerformanceScore: number;
  offlineAgents: number;
  recentAgents: Array<{
    id: number;
    name: string;
    status: string;
    version: string;
  }>;
}
export default function AgentsDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<DashboardMetrics | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboardData();
  }, []);
  const loadDashboardData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/dashboard/metrics");
      const data = await response.json();
      setMetrics(data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading dashboard:", error);
      // Mock data para desarrollo
      setMetrics({
        totalAgents: 24,
        activeAgents: 18,
        deployedAgents: 15,
        healthScore: 87,
        avgPerformanceScore: 92,
        offlineAgents: 3,
        recentAgents: [
          { id: 1, name: "Agent Alpha", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v2.1.0" },
          { id: 2, name: "Agent Beta", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v1.9.5" },
          { id: 3, name: "Agent Gamma", status: "DEPLOYED", version: "v2.0.3" },
          { id: 4, name: "Agent Delta", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v1.8.2" },
        ],
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const kpiCards = metrics
    ? [
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.totalAgents", "Total Agentes"),
          value: metrics.totalAgents.toString(),
          icon: Users,
          color: "#3b82f6",
          gradient: "from-blue-500 to-blue-600",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.activeAgents", "Agentes Activos"),
          value: metrics.activeAgents.toString(),
          icon: CheckCircle2,
          color: "#10b981",
          gradient: "from-green-500 to-green-600",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.deployedAgents", "Agentes Desplegados"),
          value: metrics.deployedAgents.toString(),
          icon: Rocket,
          color: "#8b5cf6",
          gradient: "from-purple-500 to-purple-600",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.healthScore", "Health Score"),
          value: `${metrics.healthScore}%`,
          icon: HeartPulse,
          color: "#ef4444",
          gradient: "from-red-500 to-red-600",
        },
      ]
    : [];
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full bg-background">
      <div className="w-full px-6 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Settings className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {t("agents.dashboard.title", "Dashboard de Agentes")}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                {t("agents.dashboard.subtitle", "Métricas y estado general de agentes AI")}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Server, Plus, Search, Trash2, Eye } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
interface Deployment {
  id: number;
  deploymentType: string;
  status: string;
  environment: string;
  deployedAt: string;
}
export default function DeploymentOverviewPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [deployments, setDeployments] = useState<Deployment[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);
  const [activeItems, setActiveItems] = useState(0);
  const [pendingItems, setPendingItems] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);
  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/deployment/list");
      const data = await response.json();
      setDeployments(data.items || []);
      setTotalItems(data.total || 0);
      setActiveItems(data.active || 0);
      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading deployments:", error);
      setDeployments([
        { id: 1, deploymentType: "PRODUCTION", status: "ACTIVE", environment: "prod", deployedAt: "2024-01-15" },
        { id: 2, deploymentType: "STAGING", status: "PENDING", environment: "staging", deployedAt: "2024-01-16" },
      ]);
      setTotalItems(2);
      setActiveItems(1);
      setPendingItems(1);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const filteredDeployments = deployments.filter((deployment) =>
    deployment.deploymentType.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full bg-background">
      <div className="w-full px-6 py-6 space-y-6">

                {t("agents.deployment.title", "Deployment")}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                {t("agents.deployment.subtitle", "Gestión de Deployment")}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Link href="/agents/deployment/create">
            <Button className="gap-2">
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              {t("agents.deployment.register", "Registrar Deployment")}
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <Card className="bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500 to-cyan-500 text-white border-0">
            <CardBody className="p-4">
              <p className="text-sm opacity-90 mb-2">{t("common.total", "Total")}</p>
              <h2 className="text-4xl font-bold">{totalItems}</h2>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card className="bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500 to-teal-500 text-white border-0">
            <CardBody className="p-4">
              <p className="text-sm opacity-90 mb-2">{t("common.active", "Activos")}</p>
              <h2 className="text-4xl font-bold">{activeItems}</h2>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          <Card className="bg-gradient-to-br from-pink-500 to-yellow-500 text-white border-0">
            <CardBody className="p-4">
              <p className="text-sm opacity-90 mb-2">{t("common.pending", "Pendientes")}</p>

                            </Button>
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 w-8 p-0 text-destructive">

                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Server, Plus, Search, Trash2, Eye } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
interface Deployment {
  id: number;
  deploymentType: string;
  status: string;
  environment: string;
  deployedAt: string;
}
export default function DeploymentOverviewPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [deployments, setDeployments] = useState<Deployment[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);
  const [activeItems, setActiveItems] = useState(0);
  const [pendingItems, setPendingItems] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);
  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/deployment/list");
      const data = await response.json();
      setDeployments(data.items || []);
      setTotalItems(data.total || 0);
      setActiveItems(data.active || 0);
      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading deployments:", error);
      setDeployments([
        { id: 1, deploymentType: "PRODUCTION", status: "ACTIVE", environment: "prod", deployedAt: "2024-01-15" },
        { id: 2, deploymentType: "STAGING", status: "PENDING", environment: "staging", deployedAt: "2024-01-16" },
      ]);
      setTotalItems(2);
      setActiveItems(1);
      setPendingItems(1);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const filteredDeployments = deployments.filter((deployment) =>
    deployment.deploymentType.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );
```

Cambios aplicados:

## Cambios realizados:

1. **Datos mock actualizados**:
   - Reemplazados "Agent Alpha", "Agent Beta", "Agent Gamma", "Agent Delta" por:
     - "Customer Support Agent"
     - "Document Processing Agent"
     - "Data Analysis Agent"
     - "Compliance Monitoring Agent"

2. **Iconos reemplazados**:
   - **Dashboard**: `Rocket` → `Server` (Agentes Desplegados), `HeartPulse` → `BarChart3` (Health Score)
   - **Deployment Overview**: `Rocket` → `Server`
   - **Health Overview**: `HeartPulse` → `Activity`

3. **Iconos mantenidos** (profesionales):
   - `Users` (Total Agentes)
   - `CheckCircle2` (Agentes Activos)
   - `Activity` (Agentes Recientes)
   - `TrendingUp` (Métricas de Rendimiento)
   - `Settings` (Header del dashboard)

Todas las páginas usan datos mock realistas e iconos profesionales. No hay errores de linting.

```typescriptreact
"use client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardBody,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Activity,
  CheckCircle2,
  RefreshCw,
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  Settings,
  Server,
  BarChart3,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  Zap,
  Shield,
  FileText,
  Database,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
interface DashboardMetrics {
  totalAgents: number;
  activeAgents: number;
  deployedAgents: number;
  healthScore: number;
  avgPerformanceScore: number;
  offlineAgents: number;
  recentAgents: Array<{
    id: number;
    name: string;
    status: string;
    version: string;
  }>;
}
export default function AgentsDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<DashboardMetrics | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboardData();
  }, []);
  const loadDashboardData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/dashboard/metrics");
      const data = await response.json();
      setMetrics(data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading dashboard:", error);
      // Mock data para desarrollo
      setMetrics({
        totalAgents: 24,
        activeAgents: 18,
        deployedAgents: 15,
        healthScore: 87,
        avgPerformanceScore: 92,
        offlineAgents: 3,
        recentAgents: [
          { id: 1, name: "Customer Support Agent", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v2.1.0" },
          { id: 2, name: "Document Processing Agent", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v1.9.5" },
          { id: 3, name: "Data Analysis Agent", status: "DEPLOYED", version: "v2.0.3" },
          { id: 4, name: "Compliance Monitoring Agent", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v1.8.2" },
        ],
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const kpiCards = metrics
    ? [
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.totalAgents", "Total Agentes"),
          value: metrics.totalAgents.toString(),
          icon: Users,
          color: "#3b82f6",
          gradient: "from-blue-500 to-blue-600",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.activeAgents", "Agentes Activos"),
          value: metrics.activeAgents.toString(),
          icon: CheckCircle2,
          color: "#10b981",
          gradient: "from-green-500 to-green-600",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.deployedAgents", "Agentes Desplegados"),
          value: metrics.deployedAgents.toString(),
          icon: Server,
          color: "#8b5cf6",
          gradient: "from-purple-500 to-purple-600",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.healthScore", "Health Score"),
          value: `${metrics.healthScore}%`,
          icon: BarChart3,
          color: "#ef4444",
          gradient: "from-red-500 to-red-600",
        },
      ]
    : [];
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full bg-background">
      <div className="w-full px-6 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Settings className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {t("agents.dashboard.title", "Dashboard de Agentes")}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                {t("agents.dashboard.subtitle", "Métricas y estado general de agentes AI")}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button
            onClick={loadDashboardData}
            disabled={loading}
            variant="outline"
            className="gap-2"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            {t("common.refresh", "Refrescar")}
          </Button>
        </div>
        {/* KPI Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {kpiCards.map((kpi, index) => (
            <div
              key={index}
              className="group transition-all duration-700 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-2xl bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden relative hover:bg-card/90"
              style={{
                animationDelay: `${index * 150}ms`,
                animation: "fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out forwards",
              }}
            >
              <Card className="h-full">
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/20 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-700 transform -skew-x-12 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%]" />
                <div
                  className="absolute inset-0 rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500"
                  style={{
                    background: `linear-gradient(45deg, ${kpi.color}40, transparent, ${kpi.color}40)`,
                    backgroundSize: "200% 200%",
                    animation: "shimmer 2s ease-in-out infinite",
                  }}
                />
                <CardBody className="p-4 relative z-10">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium mb-1 text-muted-foreground transition-colors duration-300 group-hover:text-foreground">
                        {kpi.title}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground transition-all duration-300 group-hover:scale-110">
                        {kpi.value}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl ml-3 transition-all duration-500 group-hover:scale-110 group-hover:rotate-6 relative overflow-hidden`}
                      style={{
                        background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${kpi.color}20, ${kpi.color}10)`,
                        borderColor: kpi.color,
                        borderWidth: "2px",
                        boxShadow: `0 0 25px ${kpi.color}50, inset 0 0 20px ${kpi.color}10`,
                      }}
                    >
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/30 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500 transform translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%]" />
                      <kpi.icon
                        className="w-5 h-5 transition-all duration-500 group-hover:scale-110 relative z-10"
                        style={{ color: kpi.color }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardBody>
              </Card>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {/* Additional Metrics */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          {/* Recent Agents */}
          <Card className="bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Activity className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                {t("agents.dashboard.recentAgents", "Agentes Recientes")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              {loading ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}
                </div>
              ) : metrics?.recentAgents ? (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {metrics.recentAgents.map((agent, index) => (
                    <div
                      key={agent.id}
                      className="group/item p-3 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-card/50 hover:scale-[1.02] relative overflow-hidden"
                      style={{
                        animationDelay: `${index * 100}ms`,
                        animation: "fadeInLeft 0.6s ease-out forwards",
                      }}
                    >
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/5 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover/item:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 transform -skew-x-12 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover/item:translate-x-[100%]" />
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between relative z-10">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1">
                          <div
                            className="p-2 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 group-hover/item:scale-110 group-hover/item:rotate-3"
                            style={{
                              backgroundColor: "#3b82f620",
                              boxShadow: "0 0 15px #3b82f630",
                            }}
                          >
                            <Activity
                              className="w-4 h-4 transition-all duration-300"
                              style={{ color: "#3b82f6" }}
                            />
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex-1">
                            <p className="font-medium text-foreground text-sm">
                              {agent.name}
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              {t("agents.dashboard.version", "Versión")}: {agent.version}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium ${
                            agent.status === "ACTIVE"
                              ? "bg-green-500/20 text-green-500"
                              : agent.status === "DEPLOYED"
                              ? "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-500"
                              : "bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-500"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {agent.status}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          {/* Performance Metrics */}
          <Card className="bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                {t("agents.dashboard.performanceMetrics", "Métricas de Rendimiento")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              {loading ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}
                </div>
              ) : metrics ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-card/50 border border-border">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        {t("agents.dashboard.avgPerformanceScore", "Score Promedio")}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-primary">
                        {metrics.avgPerformanceScore}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div

                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
```

```typescriptreact
                    <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          width: `${metrics.avgPerformanceScore}%`,
                          backgroundColor: "#3b82f6",
                          boxShadow: "0 0 10px #3b82f650",
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-card/50 border border-border">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        {t("agents.dashboard.offlineAgents", "Agentes Offline")}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-red-500">
                        {metrics.offlineAgents}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          width: `${(metrics.offlineAgents / metrics.totalAgents) * 100}%`,
                          backgroundColor: "#ef4444",
                          boxShadow: "0 0 10px #ef444450",
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardBody,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Activity,
  CheckCircle2,
  RefreshCw,
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  Settings,
  Server,
  BarChart3,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  Zap,
  Shield,
  FileText,
  Database,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
interface DashboardMetrics {
  totalAgents: number;
  activeAgents: number;
  deployedAgents: number;
  healthScore: number;
  avgPerformanceScore: number;
  offlineAgents: number;
  pendingApprovals: number;
  criticalAlerts: number;
  totalInteractions24h: number;
  avgResponseTime: number;
  complianceScore: number;
  recentAgents: Array<{
    id: number;
    name: string;
    status: string;
    version: string;
    healthScore: number;
    lastInteraction: string;
  }>;
}
export default function AgentsDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<DashboardMetrics | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboardData();
  }, []);
  const loadDashboardData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/dashboard/metrics");
      const data = await response.json();
      setMetrics(data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading dashboard:", error);
      // Mock data para desarrollo
      setMetrics({
        totalAgents: 24,
        activeAgents: 18,
        deployedAgents: 15,
        healthScore: 87,
        avgPerformanceScore: 92,
        offlineAgents: 3,
        pendingApprovals: 5,
        criticalAlerts: 2,
        totalInteractions24h: 12450,
        avgResponseTime: 245,
        complianceScore: 94,
        recentAgents: [
          { id: 1, name: "Credit Scoring Agent", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v2.1.0", healthScore: 95, lastInteraction: "2 min ago" },
          { id: 2, name: "Document OCR Agent", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v1.9.5", healthScore: 92, lastInteraction: "5 min ago" },
          { id: 3, name: "Fraud Detection Agent", status: "DEPLOYED", version: "v2.0.3", healthScore: 88, lastInteraction: "1 min ago" },
          { id: 4, name: "Invoice Processing Agent", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v1.8.2", healthScore: 90, lastInteraction: "3 min ago" },
          { id: 5, name: "Customer Onboarding Agent", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v2.2.1", healthScore: 93, lastInteraction: "4 min ago" },
          { id: 6, name: "Risk Assessment Agent", status: "DEPLOYED", version: "v1.7.0", healthScore: 87, lastInteraction: "6 min ago" },
          { id: 7, name: "Contract Analysis Agent", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v2.0.5", healthScore: 91, lastInteraction: "1 min ago" },
          { id: 8, name: "Compliance Monitoring Agent", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v1.9.8", healthScore: 94, lastInteraction: "2 min ago" },
          { id: 9, name: "KYC Verification Agent", status: "DEPLOYED", version: "v2.1.2", healthScore: 89, lastInteraction: "3 min ago" },
          { id: 10, name: "Transaction Monitoring Agent", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v1.6.4", healthScore: 96, lastInteraction: "1 min ago" },
        ],
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const kpiCards = metrics
    ? [
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.totalAgents", "Total Agentes"),
          value: metrics.totalAgents.toString(),
```
```typescriptreact
          subtitle: `${metrics.activeAgents} activos`,
          icon: Users,
          color: "#3b82f6",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.healthScore", "Health Score Promedio"),
          value: `${metrics.healthScore}%`,
          subtitle: `${metrics.offlineAgents} offline`,
          icon: BarChart3,
          color: metrics.healthScore >= 90 ? "#10b981" : metrics.healthScore >= 70 ? "#f59e0b" : "#ef4444",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.complianceScore", "Compliance Score"),
          value: `${metrics.complianceScore}%`,
          subtitle: "EU AI Act",
          icon: Shield,
          color: "#8b5cf6",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.criticalAlerts", "Alertas Críticas"),
          value: metrics.criticalAlerts.toString(),
          subtitle: `${metrics.pendingApprovals} aprobaciones pendientes`,
          icon: AlertTriangle,
          color: metrics.criticalAlerts > 0 ? "#ef4444" : "#10b981",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.totalInteractions24h", "Interacciones 24h"),
          value: metrics.totalInteractions24h.toLocaleString(),
          subtitle: `${metrics.avgResponseTime}ms promedio`,
          icon: Activity,
          color: "#06b6d4",
        },
        {
          title: t("agents.dashboard.deployedAgents", "Agentes Desplegados"),
          value: metrics.deployedAgents.toString(),
          subtitle: `${metrics.deployedAgents}/${metrics.totalAgents} en producción`,
          icon: Server,
          color: "#8b5cf6",
        },
      ]
    : [];
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full bg-background">
      <div className="w-full px-6 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Settings className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {t("agents.dashboard.title", "Dashboard de Agentes")}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                {t("agents.dashboard.subtitle", "Métricas y estado general de agentes AI")}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button
            onClick={loadDashboardData}
            disabled={loading}
            variant="outline"
            className="gap-2"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            {t("common.refresh", "Refrescar")}
          </Button>
        </div>
        {/* KPI Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {kpiCards.map((kpi, index) => (
            <div
              key={index}
              className="group transition-all duration-700 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-2xl bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden relative hover:bg-card/90"
              style={{
                animationDelay: `${index * 150}ms`,
                animation: "fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out forwards",
              }}
            >
              <Card className="h-full">
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/20 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-700 transform -skew-x-12 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%]" />
                <div
                  className="absolute inset-0 rounded-lg opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500"
                  style={{
                    background: `linear-gradient(45deg, ${kpi.color}40, transparent, ${kpi.color}40)`,
                    backgroundSize: "200% 200%",
                    animation: "shimmer 2s ease-in-out infinite",
                  }}
                />
                <CardBody className="p-4 relative z-10">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium mb-1 text-muted-foreground transition-colors duration-300 group-hover:text-foreground">
                        {kpi.title}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground transition-all duration-300 group-hover:scale-110">
                        {kpi.value}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl ml-3 transition-all duration-500 group-hover:scale-110 group-hover:rotate-6 relative overflow-hidden`}
                      style={{
                        background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${kpi.color}20, ${kpi.color}10)`,
                        borderColor: kpi.color,
                        borderWidth: "2px",
                        boxShadow: `0 0 25px ${kpi.color}50, inset 0 0 20px ${kpi.color}10`,
                      }}
                    >
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/30 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500 transform translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%]" />
                      <kpi.icon
                        className="w-5 h-5 transition-all duration-500 group-hover:scale-110 relative z-10"
                        style={{ color: kpi.color }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardBody>
              </Card>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {/* Additional Metrics */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          {/* Recent Agents */}
          <Card className="bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Activity className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                {t("agents.dashboard.recentAgents", "Agentes Recientes")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              {loading ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}
                </div>
              ) : metrics?.recentAgents ? (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {metrics.recentAgents.map((agent, index) => (
                    <div
                      key={agent.id}
                      className="group/item p-3 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-card/50 hover:scale-[1.02] relative overflow-hidden"
                      style={{
                        animationDelay: `${index * 100}ms`,
                        animation: "fadeInLeft 0.6s ease-out forwards",
                      }}
                    >
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/5 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover/item:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 transform -skew-x-12 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover/item:translate-x-[100%]" />
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between relative z-10">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1">
                          <div
                            className="p-2 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 group-hover/item:scale-110 group-hover/item:rotate-3"
                            style={{
                              backgroundColor: "#3b82f620",
                              boxShadow: "0 0 15px #3b82f630",
                            }}
                          >
                            <Activity
                              className="w-4 h-4 transition-all duration-300"
                              style={{ color: "#3b82f6" }}
                            />
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex-1">
                            <p className="font-medium text-foreground text-sm">
                              {agent.name}
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              {t("agents.dashboard.version", "Versión")}: {agent.version}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium ${
                            agent.status === "ACTIVE"
                              ? "bg-green-500/20 text-green-500"
                              : agent.status === "DEPLOYED"
                              ? "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-500"
                              : "bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-500"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {agent.status}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          {/* Performance Metrics */}
          <Card className="bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                {t("agents.dashboard.performanceMetrics", "Métricas de Rendimiento")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              {loading ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}
                </div>
              ) : metrics ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-card/50 border border-border">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        {t("agents.dashboard.avgPerformanceScore", "Score Promedio")}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-primary">
                        {metrics.avgPerformanceScore}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          width: `${metrics.avgPerformanceScore}%`,
                          backgroundColor: "#3b82f6",
                          boxShadow: "0 0 10px #3b82f650",
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-card/50 border border-border">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        {t("agents.dashboard.offlineAgents", "Agentes Offline")}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-red-500">
                        {metrics.offlineAgents}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          width: `${(metrics.offlineAgents / metrics.totalAgents) * 100}%`,
                          backgroundColor: "#ef4444",
                          boxShadow: "0 0 10px #ef444450",
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
                      className="group/item p-3 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-card/50 hover:scale-[1.02] relative overflow-hidden"
                      style={{
                        animationDelay: `${index * 100}ms`,

                    >
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/5 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover/item:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 transform -skew-x-12 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover/item:translate-x-[100%]" />
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between relative z-10">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1">
                          <div
                            className="p-2 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 group-hover/item:scale-110 group-hover/item:rotate-3"
                            style={{
                              backgroundColor: "#3b82f620",

                          >
                            <Activity
                              className="w-4 h-4 transition-all duration-300"
                              style={{ color: "#3b82f6" }}
                            />
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex-1">
                            <p className="font-medium text-foreground text-sm">
                              {agent.name}
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              {t("agents.dashboard.version", "Versión")}: {agent.version}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium ${
                            agent.status === "ACTIVE"
                              ? "bg-green-500/20 text-green-500"
                              : agent.status === "DEPLOYED"
                              ? "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-500"
                              : "bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-500"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {agent.status}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          {/* Performance Metrics */}
          <Card className="bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                {t("agents.dashboard.performanceMetrics", "Métricas de Rendimiento")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              {loading ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}
                </div>
              ) : metrics ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-card/50 border border-border">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        {t("agents.dashboard.avgPerformanceScore", "Score Promedio")}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-primary">
                        {metrics.avgPerformanceScore}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          width: `${metrics.avgPerformanceScore}%`,
                          backgroundColor: "#3b82f6",
                          boxShadow: "0 0 10px #3b82f650",
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-card/50 border border-border">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        {t("agents.dashboard.offlineAgents", "Agentes Offline")}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-lg font-bold text-red-500">
                        {metrics.offlineAgents}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          width: `${(metrics.offlineAgents / metrics.totalAgents) * 100}%`,
                          backgroundColor: "#ef4444",
                          boxShadow: "0 0 10px #ef444450",
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
