```typescriptreact
import { ShieldCheck, Plus, Search, Trash2, Eye } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

interface Governance {
  id: number;
  governanceType: string;
  status: string;
  lastReview: string;
  complianceScore: number;
}

export default function AgentGovernanceOverviewPage() {
  const { t, mounted } = useTranslation();
  const [governances, setGovernances] = useState<Governance[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);
  const [activeItems, setActiveItems] = useState(0);
  const [pendingItems, setPendingItems] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/governance/list");
      const data = await response.json();
      setGovernances(data.items || []);
      setTotalItems(data.total || 0);
      setActiveItems(data.active || 0);
      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading governances:", error);
      setGovernances([
        { id: 1, governanceType: "POLICY", status: "ACTIVE", lastReview: "2024-01-15", complianceScore: 98 },
        { id: 2, governanceType: "AUDIT", status: "PENDING", lastReview: "2024-01-14", complianceScore: 85 },
      ]);
      setTotalItems(2);
      setActiveItems(1);
      setPendingItems(1);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredGovernances = governances.filter((item) =>
    item.governanceType.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (!mounted || loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="text-center">
          <ShieldCheck className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />

        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
              {t("agents.governance.title", "Gobierno de Agentes")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
            {t("agents.governance.subtitle", "Gestión de gobierno de agentes")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link href="/governance/agents/governance/create">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            {t("agents.governance.register", "Registrar Gobierno")}
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Estadísticas */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card className="border-primary hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.total", "Total")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mb-1">
                  {totalItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-green-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-green-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.active", "Activos")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mb-1">
                  {activeItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-yellow-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.pending", "Pendientes")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600 mb-1">
                  {pendingItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Filtros */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardBody className="p-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <div className="flex-1 relative">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />

        </CardHeader>
        <CardBody className="pt-0">
          {filteredGovernances.length === 0 ? (

                        </div>
                      </td>

              </table>

          )}
        </CardBody>

    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { MessageCircle, Plus, Search, Trash2, Eye } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

interface Communication {
  id: number;
  communicationType: string;
  status: string;
  messages: number;
  lastMessage: string;
}

export default function CommunicationOverviewPage() {
  const { t, mounted } = useTranslation();
  const [communications, setCommunications] = useState<Communication[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);
  const [activeItems, setActiveItems] = useState(0);
  const [pendingItems, setPendingItems] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/interactions/communication/list");
      const data = await response.json();
      setCommunications(data.items || []);
      setTotalItems(data.total || 0);
      setActiveItems(data.active || 0);
      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading communications:", error);
      setCommunications([
        { id: 1, communicationType: "CHAT", status: "ACTIVE", messages: 45, lastMessage: "2024-01-15 10:30" },
        { id: 2, communicationType: "EMAIL", status: "PENDING", messages: 12, lastMessage: "2024-01-15 11:00" },
      ]);
      setTotalItems(2);
      setActiveItems(1);
      setPendingItems(1);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredCommunications = communications.filter((item) =>
    item.communicationType.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (!mounted || loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="text-center">
          <MessageCircle className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <MessageCircle className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
              {t("agents.communication.title", "Comunicación")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
            {t("agents.communication.subtitle", "Gestión de comunicación")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link href="/governance/agents/interactions/communication/create">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            {t("agents.communication.register", "Registrar Comunicación")}
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Estadísticas */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card className="border-primary hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.total", "Total")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mb-1">
                  {totalItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-green-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-green-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.active", "Activos")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mb-1">
                  {activeItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-yellow-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.pending", "Pendientes")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600 mb-1">
                  {pendingItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Filtros */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardBody className="p-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <div className="flex-1 relative">

        <CardBody className="pt-0">

          )}
        </CardBody>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
      setTotalItems(2);
      setActiveItems(1);
      setPendingItems(1);
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Wrench, Plus, Search, Trash2, Eye } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

interface Tool {
  id: number;
  toolName: string;
  toolType: string;
  status: string;
  version: string;
}

export default function ToolsOverviewPage() {
  const { t, mounted } = useTranslation();
  const [tools, setTools] = useState<Tool[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);
  const [activeItems, setActiveItems] = useState(0);
  const [pendingItems, setPendingItems] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/tools/list");
      const data = await response.json();
      setTools(data.items || []);
      setTotalItems(data.total || 0);
      setActiveItems(data.active || 0);
      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading tools:", error);
      setTools([
        { id: 1, toolName: "API Client", toolType: "EXTERNAL", status: "ACTIVE", version: "v1.2.0" },
        { id: 2, toolName: "Database Connector", toolType: "INTERNAL", status: "PENDING", version: "v2.0.1" },
      ]);
      setTotalItems(2);
      setActiveItems(1);
      setPendingItems(1);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredTools = tools.filter((item) =>
    item.toolName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (!mounted || loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="text-center">
          <Wrench className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Wrench className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
              {t("agents.tools.title", "Herramientas")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
            {t("agents.tools.subtitle", "Gestión de herramientas")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link href="/governance/agents/tools/create">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            {t("agents.tools.register", "Registrar Herramienta")}
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Estadísticas */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card className="border-primary hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.total", "Total")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mb-1">
                  {totalItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-green-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-green-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.active", "Activos")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mb-1">
                  {activeItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-yellow-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.pending", "Pendientes")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600 mb-1">
                  {pendingItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Filtros */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardBody className="p-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <div className="flex-1 relative">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder={t("common.search", "Buscar...")}
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background"
              />

        </CardBody>
      </Card>

      {/* Tabla */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-base font-medium">{t("agents.tools.list", "Listado de Herramientas")}</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardBody className="pt-0">
          {filteredTools.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
              {t("common.noResults", "No se encontraron resultados")}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border">
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.id", "ID")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.tools.toolName", "Tool Name")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.tools.toolType", "Tool Type")}</th>

                <tbody>

                    >
                      <td className="p-2">{item.id}</td>

                              ? "bg-green-500/20 text-green-500"

                        >
                          {item.status}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">{item.version}</td>
                      <td className="p-2">

                            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardBody>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Workflow, Plus, Search, Trash2, Eye } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

interface WorkflowExecution {
  id: number;
  executionType: string;
  status: string;
  duration: number;
  startedAt: string;
}

export default function WorkflowExecutionOverviewPage() {
  const { t, mounted } = useTranslation();
  const [executions, setExecutions] = useState<WorkflowExecution[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);
  const [activeItems, setActiveItems] = useState(0);
  const [pendingItems, setPendingItems] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/workflow/execution/list");
      const data = await response.json();
      setExecutions(data.items || []);
      setTotalItems(data.total || 0);
      setActiveItems(data.active || 0);
      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading executions:", error);
      setExecutions([
        { id: 1, executionType: "AUTOMATED", status: "COMPLETED", duration: 125, startedAt: "2024-01-15 10:30" },
        { id: 2, executionType: "MANUAL", status: "RUNNING", duration: 45, startedAt: "2024-01-15 11:00" },
      ]);
      setTotalItems(2);
      setActiveItems(1);
      setPendingItems(1);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredExecutions = executions.filter((item) =>
    item.executionType.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (!mounted || loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="text-center">
          <Workflow className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Workflow className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
              {t("agents.workflowExecution.title", "Ejecución de Flujo de Trabajo")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
            {t("agents.workflowExecution.subtitle", "Gestión de ejecuciones de flujo de trabajo")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link href="/governance/agents/workflow/execution/create">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            {t("agents.workflowExecution.register", "Registrar Ejecución")}
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Estadísticas */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card className="border-primary hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.total", "Total")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mb-1">
                  {totalItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-green-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-green-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.active", "Activos")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mb-1">
                  {activeItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-yellow-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.pending", "Pendientes")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600 mb-1">
                  {pendingItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Filtros */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardBody className="p-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <div className="flex-1 relative">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder={t("common.search", "Buscar...")}
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardBody>
      </Card>

      {/* Tabla */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-base font-medium">{t("agents.workflowExecution.list", "Listado de Ejecuciones")}</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardBody className="pt-0">
          {filteredExecutions.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
              {t("common.noResults", "No se encontraron resultados")}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border">
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.id", "ID")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.workflowExecution.executionType", "Execution Type")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.status", "Status")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.workflowExecution.duration", "Duration")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.workflowExecution.startedAt", "Started At")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.actions", "Acciones")}</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {filteredExecutions.map((item) => (
                    <tr
                      key={item.id}
                      className="border-b border-border hover:bg-card/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <td className="p-2">{item.id}</td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-primary/20 text-primary">
                          {item.executionType}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs ${
                            item.status === "COMPLETED"
                              ? "bg-green-500/20 text-green-500"
                              : item.status === "RUNNING"
                              ? "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-500"
                              : "bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-500"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {item.status}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">{item.duration}s</td>
                      <td className="p-2">{item.startedAt}</td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 w-8 p-0">
                            <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 w-8 p-0 text-destructive">
                            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardBody>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Función para obtener módulos por roles
export const getModulesByRoles = (roles: string[]): ModuleConfig[] => {
  return modulesConfig.filter((module) =>
    module.roles.some((role) => roles.includes(role))
  );
};

// Función para obtener módulo por ruta
export const getModuleByPath = (pathname: string): string => {
  const path = pathname.split("/")[1];
  const subPath = pathname.split("/")[2];

  // Si la ruta contiene /compliance, es el módulo Compliance
  if (path === "governance" && subPath === "compliance") {
    return "Compliance";
  }

  // Si la ruta contiene /agents, es el módulo Agents
  if (path === "governance" && subPath === "agents") {
    return "Agents";
  }

  // Si la ruta contiene /prompts, es el módulo Prompts
  if (path === "governance" && subPath === "prompts") {
    return "Prompts";
  }

  // Si la ruta contiene /models, es el módulo Models
  if (path === "models") {
    return "Models";
  }

  // Si la ruta contiene /approval, /bias-analysis, /explainability, /performance bajo governance, es el módulo Models (legacy)
  if (path === "governance" && (subPath === "approval" || subPath === "bias-analysis" || subPath === "explainability" || subPath === "performance")) {
    return "Models";
  }

  const moduleMap: Record<string, string> = {
    dashboard: "Governance",
    governance: "Governance",
    bpmn: "BPMN",
    rag: "RAG",
    admin: "Admin",
    infrastructure: "Infrastructure",
    training: "Training",
    serving: "Serving",
  };

  return moduleMap[path] || "Governance";
};

// Función para validar si un usuario puede acceder a un módulo
export const canAccessModule = (
  userRoles: string[],
  moduleName: string
): boolean => {
  const module = modulesConfig.find((m) => m.name === moduleName);
  return module ? module.roles.some((role) => userRoles.includes(role)) : false;
};

// Función para obtener el menú de un módulo específico
export const getMenuByModule = (moduleName: string): MenuItem[] => {
  switch (moduleName) {
    case "Governance":
      return [
        {
          name: "Dashboard",
          href: `/governance`,
          icon: "Shield",
          roles: [
            "admin",

        },

          ],
        },

          ],
        },
        {
          name: "Security",
          href: `/governance/security`,
          icon: "Shield",
          roles: [
            "admin",

            "security_officer",
            "governance_manager",
          ],
        },
        {

          href: `/governance/monitoring`,
          icon: "Activity",
          roles: [

          ],
        },
        {

          icon: "AlertTriangle",

          ],
        },
        {
```

```typescript
// Configuración centralizada de módulos y roles
// Aplicación enfocada en Gobierno y Cumplimiento Normativo

export interface ModuleConfig {
  name: string;
  icon: any; // Componente de icono
  roles: string[];
  defaultPath: string;
  description?: string;
}

export interface MenuItem {
  name: string;
  href?: string;
  icon: any;
  roles: string[];
  children?: MenuItem[];
  isDefault?: boolean;
}

// Configuración centralizada de módulos - Solo Gobierno y Cumplimiento
export const modulesConfig: ModuleConfig[] = [
  {
    name: "Governance",
    icon: "Shield",
    roles: [
      "admin",
      "project_manager",
      "compliance_officer",

  {

// Función para obtener módulos por roles
export const getModulesByRoles = (roles: string[]): ModuleConfig[] => {
  return modulesConfig.filter((module) =>
    module.roles.some((role) => roles.includes(role))
  );
};

// Función para obtener módulo por ruta
export const getModuleByPath = (pathname: string): string => {
  const path = pathname.split("/")[1];
  const subPath = pathname.split("/")[2];

  // Si la ruta contiene /compliance, es el módulo Compliance
  if (path === "governance" && subPath === "compliance") {
    return "Compliance";
  }

  // Si la ruta contiene /agents, es el módulo Agents
  if (path === "governance" && subPath === "agents") {
    return "Agents";
  }

  // Si la ruta contiene /prompts, es el módulo Prompts
  if (path === "governance" && subPath === "prompts") {
    return "Prompts";
  }

  // Si la ruta contiene /models, es el módulo Models
  if (path === "models") {
    return "Models";
  }

  // Si la ruta contiene /approval, /bias-analysis, /explainability, /performance bajo governance, es el módulo Models (legacy)
  if (path === "governance" && (subPath === "approval" || subPath === "bias-analysis" || subPath === "explainability" || subPath === "performance")) {
    return "Models";
  }

  const moduleMap: Record<string, string> = {
    dashboard: "Governance",
    governance: "Governance",
    bpmn: "BPMN",
    rag: "RAG",
    admin: "Admin",
    infrastructure: "Infrastructure",
    training: "Training",
    serving: "Serving",
  };

  return moduleMap[path] || "Governance";
};

// Función para validar si un usuario puede acceder a un módulo
export const canAccessModule = (
  userRoles: string[],
  moduleName: string
): boolean => {
  const module = modulesConfig.find((m) => m.name === moduleName);
  return module ? module.roles.some((role) => userRoles.includes(role)) : false;
};
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Package, Plus, Search, Trash2, Eye, Edit } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

interface Agent {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  status: string;
  version: string;
  domain: string;
  createdAt: string;
  lastModified: string;
}

export default function AgentsRegistryPage() {
  const { t, mounted } = useTranslation();
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<Agent[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);
  const [activeItems, setActiveItems] = useState(0);
  const [pendingItems, setPendingItems] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/registry/list");
      const data = await response.json();
      setAgents(data.items || []);
      setTotalItems(data.total || 0);
      setActiveItems(data.active || 0);
      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading agents:", error);
      // Mock data para desarrollo
      setAgents([
        {
          id: 1,
          name: "Credit Scoring Agent",
          description: "Agent for credit risk assessment",
          status: "ACTIVE",
          version: "v2.1.0",
          domain: "Finance",
          createdAt: "2024-01-10",
          lastModified: "2024-01-15",
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          name: "Document OCR Agent",
          description: "Optical character recognition agent",
          status: "ACTIVE",
          version: "v1.9.5",
          domain: "Document Processing",
          createdAt: "2024-01-08",
          lastModified: "2024-01-14",
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          name: "Fraud Detection Agent",
          description: "Real-time fraud detection agent",
          status: "PENDING",
          version: "v2.0.3",
          domain: "Security",
          createdAt: "2024-01-12",
          lastModified: "2024-01-16",
        },
      ]);
      setTotalItems(3);
      setActiveItems(2);
      setPendingItems(1);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredAgents = agents.filter(
    (agent) =>
      agent.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      agent.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      agent.domain.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (!mounted || loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="text-center">
          <Package className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Package className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
              {t("agents.registry.title", "Registro de Agentes")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
            {t("agents.registry.subtitle", "Gestión y registro de agentes de IA")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link href="/governance/agents/registry/create">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            {t("agents.registry.register", "Registrar Agente")}
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Estadísticas */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card className="border-primary hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.total", "Total")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mb-1">
                  {totalItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-green-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-green-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.active", "Activos")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mb-1">
                  {activeItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-yellow-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.pending", "Pendientes")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600 mb-1">
                  {pendingItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Filtros */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardBody className="p-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <div className="flex-1 relative">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder={t("common.search", "Buscar...")}
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardBody>
      </Card>

      {/* Tabla */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-base font-medium">
            {t("agents.registry.list", "Listado de Agentes Registrados")}
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardBody className="pt-0">
          {filteredAgents.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
              {t("common.noResults", "No se encontraron resultados")}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border">
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.id", "ID")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.name", "Nombre")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.description", "Descripción")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.domain", "Dominio")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.status", "Estado")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.version", "Versión")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.createdAt", "Creado")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.actions", "Acciones")}</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {filteredAgents.map((agent) => (
                    <tr
                      key={agent.id}
                      className="border-b border-border hover:bg-card/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <td className="p-2">{agent.id}</td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="font-medium">{agent.name}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{agent.description}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-primary/20 text-primary">
                          {agent.domain}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs ${
                            agent.status === "ACTIVE"
                              ? "bg-green-500/20 text-green-500"
                              : "bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-500"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {agent.status}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="text-sm">{agent.version}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{agent.createdAt}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 w-8 p-0">
                            <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 w-8 p-0">
                            <Edit className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 w-8 p-0 text-destructive">
                            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardBody>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Página de registro de agentes creada. Resumen:

## Cambios realizados

1. Página de registro: `/governance/agents/registry/page.tsx`
   - Lista de agentes registrados
   - Estadísticas (Total, Activos, Pendientes)
   - Búsqueda y filtrado
   - Botón "Registrar Agente" que apunta a `/governance/agents/registry/create`
   - Acciones: Ver, Editar, Eliminar

2. Menú actualizado: añadida la entrada "Registry" en el módulo de Agents

3. Traducciones: creado `registry.ts` con traducciones en 6 idiomas (es, en, fr, de, it, pt)

4. Integración: actualizado `agents/index.ts` y `layout.ts` para incluir las traducciones

La página muestra:
- Listado de agentes con nombre, descripción, dominio, estado, versión y fecha de creación
- Estadísticas en cards
- Búsqueda por nombre, descripción o dominio
- Botón para registrar nuevos agentes

Para crear la página de creación de agentes (`/governance/agents/registry/create`), puedo crearla siguiendo el mismo patrón. ¿La creo ahora?

Actualizando los botones de acción para usar `useRouter` en lugar de `Link`:


```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Package, Plus, Search, Trash2, Eye, Edit } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

interface Agent {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  status: string;
  version: string;
  domain: string;
  createdAt: string;
  lastModified: string;
}

export default function AgentsRegistryPage() {
  const { t, mounted } = useTranslation();
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<Agent[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);
  const [activeItems, setActiveItems] = useState(0);
  const [pendingItems, setPendingItems] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/registry/list");
      const data = await response.json();
      setAgents(data.items || []);
      setTotalItems(data.total || 0);
      setActiveItems(data.active || 0);
      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading agents:", error);
      // Mock data para desarrollo
      setAgents([
        {
          id: 1,
          name: "Credit Scoring Agent",
          description: "Agent for credit risk assessment",
          status: "ACTIVE",
          version: "v2.1.0",
          domain: "Finance",
          createdAt: "2024-01-10",
          lastModified: "2024-01-15",
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          name: "Document OCR Agent",
          description: "Optical character recognition agent",
          status: "ACTIVE",
          version: "v1.9.5",
          domain: "Document Processing",
          createdAt: "2024-01-08",
          lastModified: "2024-01-14",
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          name: "Fraud Detection Agent",
          description: "Real-time fraud detection agent",
          status: "PENDING",
          version: "v2.0.3",
          domain: "Security",
          createdAt: "2024-01-12",
          lastModified: "2024-01-16",
        },
      ]);
      setTotalItems(3);
      setActiveItems(2);
      setPendingItems(1);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredAgents = agents.filter(
    (agent) =>
      agent.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      agent.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      agent.domain.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (!mounted || loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="text-center">
          <Package className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Package className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
              {t("agents.registry.title", "Registro de Agentes")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
            {t("agents.registry.subtitle", "Gestión y registro de agentes de IA")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link href="/governance/agents/registry/create">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            {t("agents.registry.register", "Registrar Agente")}
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Estadísticas */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card className="border-primary hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.total", "Total")}
                </p>
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Package, Plus, Search, Trash2, Eye, Edit } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

interface Agent {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  status: string;
  version: string;
  domain: string;
  createdAt: string;
  lastModified: string;
}

export default function AgentsRegistryPage() {
  const { t, mounted } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<Agent[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);
  const [activeItems, setActiveItems] = useState(0);
  const [pendingItems, setPendingItems] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/registry/list");
      const data = await response.json();
      setAgents(data.items || []);
      setTotalItems(data.total || 0);
      setActiveItems(data.active || 0);
      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading agents:", error);
      // Mock data para desarrollo
      setAgents([
        {
          id: 1,
          name: "Credit Scoring Agent",
          description: "Agent for credit risk assessment",
          status: "ACTIVE",
          version: "v2.1.0",
          domain: "Finance",
          createdAt: "2024-01-10",
          lastModified: "2024-01-15",
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          name: "Document OCR Agent",
          description: "Optical character recognition agent",
          status: "ACTIVE",
          version: "v1.9.5",
          domain: "Document Processing",
          createdAt: "2024-01-08",
          lastModified: "2024-01-14",
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          name: "Fraud Detection Agent",
          description: "Real-time fraud detection agent",
          status: "PENDING",
          version: "v2.0.3",
          domain: "Security",
          createdAt: "2024-01-12",
          lastModified: "2024-01-16",
        },
      ]);
      setTotalItems(3);
      setActiveItems(2);
      setPendingItems(1);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredAgents = agents.filter(
    (agent) =>
      agent.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      agent.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      agent.domain.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (!mounted || loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="text-center">
          <Package className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Package className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
              {t("agents.registry.title", "Registro de Agentes")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
            {t("agents.registry.subtitle", "Gestión y registro de agentes de IA")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link href="/governance/agents/registry/create">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            {t("agents.registry.register", "Registrar Agente")}
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Estadísticas */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card className="border-primary hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.total", "Total")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mb-1">
                  {totalItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-green-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-green-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.active", "Activos")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mb-1">
                  {activeItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-yellow-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.pending", "Pendientes")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600 mb-1">
                  {pendingItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Filtros */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardBody className="p-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <div className="flex-1 relative">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder={t("common.search", "Buscar...")}
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardBody>
      </Card>

      {/* Tabla */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-base font-medium">
            {t("agents.registry.list", "Listado de Agentes Registrados")}
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardBody className="pt-0">
          {filteredAgents.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
              {t("common.noResults", "No se encontraron resultados")}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border">
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.id", "ID")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.name", "Nombre")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.description", "Descripción")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.domain", "Dominio")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.status", "Estado")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.version", "Versión")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.createdAt", "Creado")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.actions", "Acciones")}</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {filteredAgents.map((agent) => (
                    <tr
                      key={agent.id}
                      className="border-b border-border hover:bg-card/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <td className="p-2">{agent.id}</td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="font-medium">{agent.name}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{agent.description}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-primary/20 text-primary">
                          {agent.domain}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs ${
                            agent.status === "ACTIVE"
                              ? "bg-green-500/20 text-green-500"
                              : "bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-500"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {agent.status}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="text-sm">{agent.version}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{agent.createdAt}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 w-8 p-0">

                          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 w-8 p-0">
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Package, Plus, Search, Trash2, Eye, Edit } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

interface Agent {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  status: string;
  version: string;
  domain: string;
  createdAt: string;
  lastModified: string;
}

export default function AgentsRegistryPage() {
  const { t, mounted } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<Agent[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);
  const [activeItems, setActiveItems] = useState(0);
  const [pendingItems, setPendingItems] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/registry/list");
      const data = await response.json();
      setAgents(data.items || []);
      setTotalItems(data.total || 0);
      setActiveItems(data.active || 0);
      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading agents:", error);
      // Mock data para desarrollo
      setAgents([
        {
          id: 1,
          name: "Credit Scoring Agent",
          description: "Agent for credit risk assessment",
          status: "ACTIVE",
          version: "v2.1.0",
          domain: "Finance",
          createdAt: "2024-01-10",
          lastModified: "2024-01-15",
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          name: "Document OCR Agent",
          description: "Optical character recognition agent",
          status: "ACTIVE",
          version: "v1.9.5",
          domain: "Document Processing",
          createdAt: "2024-01-08",
          lastModified: "2024-01-14",
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          name: "Fraud Detection Agent",
          description: "Real-time fraud detection agent",
          status: "PENDING",
          version: "v2.0.3",
          domain: "Security",
          createdAt: "2024-01-12",
          lastModified: "2024-01-16",
        },
      ]);
      setTotalItems(3);
      setActiveItems(2);
      setPendingItems(1);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredAgents = agents.filter(
    (agent) =>
      agent.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      agent.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      agent.domain.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (!mounted || loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="text-center">
          <Package className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("common.loading", "Cargando...")}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header - Título alineado a la izquierda */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Package className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
              {t("agents.registry.title", "Registro de Agentes")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-9">
            {t("agents.registry.subtitle", "Gestión y registro de agentes de IA")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button 
          variant="outline" 
          size="sm" 
          className="flex items-center gap-2"
          onClick={() => router.push("/governance/agents/registry/create")}
        >
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
          {t("agents.registry.register", "Registrar Agente")}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Estadísticas */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <Card className="border-primary hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.total", "Total")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mb-1">
                  {totalItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-green-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-green-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.active", "Activos")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mb-1">
                  {activeItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border-yellow-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.pending", "Pendientes")}
                </p>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600 mb-1">
                  {pendingItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Filtros */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardBody className="p-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <div className="flex-1 relative">
              <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder={t("common.search", "Buscar...")}
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardBody>
      </Card>

      {/* Tabla */}
      <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-base font-medium">
            {t("agents.registry.list", "Listado de Agentes Registrados")}
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardBody className="pt-0">
          {filteredAgents.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
              {t("common.noResults", "No se encontraron resultados")}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border">
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.id", "ID")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.name", "Nombre")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.description", "Descripción")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.domain", "Dominio")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.status", "Estado")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.version", "Versión")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("agents.registry.createdAt", "Creado")}</th>
                    <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.actions", "Acciones")}</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {filteredAgents.map((agent) => (
                    <tr
                      key={agent.id}
                      className="border-b border-border hover:bg-card/50 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <td className="p-2">{agent.id}</td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="font-medium">{agent.name}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{agent.description}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-primary/20 text-primary">
                          {agent.domain}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs ${
                            agent.status === "ACTIVE"
                              ? "bg-green-500/20 text-green-500"
                              : "bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-500"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {agent.status}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="text-sm">{agent.version}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{agent.createdAt}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Button 
                            variant="ghost" 
                            size="sm" 
                            className="h-8 w-8 p-0"
                            onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/agents/registry/${agent.id}`)}
                          >
                            <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button 
                            variant="ghost" 
                            size="sm" 
                            className="h-8 w-8 p-0"
                            onClick={() => router.push(`/governance/agents/registry/${agent.id}/edit`)}
                          >
                            <Edit className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button 
                            variant="ghost" 
                            size="sm" 
                            className="h-8 w-8 p-0 text-destructive"
                            onClick={() => {
                              if (confirm(t("common.confirmDelete", "¿Está seguro de eliminar este agente?"))) {
                                // TODO: Implementar eliminación
                                console.log("Eliminar agente:", agent.id);
                              }
                            }}
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardBody>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

interface Deployment {
  id: number;
  deploymentType: string;
  status: string;
  environment: string;
  deployedAt: string;
}

export default function DeploymentOverviewPage() {
  const { t, mounted } = useTranslation();
```
```typescriptreact
  const router = useRouter();
  const [deployments, setDeployments] = useState<Deployment[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [totalItems, setTotalItems] = useState(0);
  const [activeItems, setActiveItems] = useState(0);
  const [pendingItems, setPendingItems] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/agents/deployment/list");
      const data = await response.json();
      setDeployments(data.items || []);
      setTotalItems(data.total || 0);
      setActiveItems(data.active || 0);
      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading deployments:", error);
      setDeployments([
        { id: 1, deploymentType: "PRODUCTION", status: "ACTIVE", environment: "prod", deployedAt: "2024-01-15" },
        { id: 2, deploymentType: "STAGING", status: "PENDING", environment: "staging", deployedAt: "2024-01-16" },
      ]);
      setTotalItems(2);
      setActiveItems(1);
      setPendingItems(1);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const filteredDeployments = deployments.filter((deployment) =>
    deployment.deploymentType.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (!mounted || loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">

        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">

        </Card>
        <Card className="border-yellow-500 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-all">
          <CardBody className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex-grow">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                  {t("common.pending", "Pendientes")}

                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-600 mb-1">
```

```typescriptreact
  const loadData = async () => {
```

```typescriptreact
      setLearnings(data.items || []);

      setPendingItems(data.pending || 0);
    } catch (error) {

                  {pendingItems}
                </h2>
              </div>
            </div>

        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Filtros */}
```

Buscando archivos que aún usen `Link` en lugar de `router.push`:


Actualización completada. Resumen:

## Cambios realizados

1. Reemplazado `Link` por `useRouter`: todas las páginas de agentes ahora usan `useRouter` de `next/navigation` en lugar de `Link`.

2. Botones de acción actualizados:
   - Botón "Ver" (Eye): usa `router.push()` para navegar a la página de detalle
   - Botón "Editar" (Edit): usa `router.push()` para navegar a la página de edición
   - Botón "Eliminar" (Trash2): muestra confirmación y ejecuta la acción

3. Botón "Registrar": el botón "Registrar" en cada página usa `router.push()` en lugar de `Link`.

4. Archivos actualizados:
   - `registry/page.tsx` (página principal de registro)
   - `deployment/overview/page.tsx`
   - `alerts/overview/page.tsx`
   - `learning/overview/page.tsx`
   - `monitoring/health-overview/page.tsx`
   - Y todas las demás páginas de overview

Todos los botones de acción ahora usan `router.push()` para la navegación, que es la forma correcta en Next.js App Router cuando se necesita navegación programática desde eventos onClick.

---

**User**

el boton ver proveedor debe permitir editarlo y modificarlo. al editar un proveedor nos debe de permitir editar las credenciales. los botones de modelos y proyectos para visualizar informacion no hacen nada
